profile.title: Backend Software Developer
profile.tagline: Backend Software Developer specializing in Java, Spring Boot & Quarkus. Building scalable microservices, REST APIs, and event-driven systems with strong observability practices using Grafana.

projects.title: Tahadhari
projects.description: A WhatsApp-based early warning alert system for East Africa, built with a three-person hackathon team. Owns the AI and language layer using FastAPI, the Claude API, and Twilio for message delivery.

projects.title: Gatestack
projects.description: An event ticketing platform built with Quarkus 3 and a React 18/TypeScript frontend. Set up CI/CD pipelines with JaCoCo and Vitest, and implemented multi-currency exchange rate support.

projects.title: Dondoo Homes
projects.description: A full-stack property management platform using Quarkus 3, React 19, and PostgreSQL. Integrated Keycloak for identity and access management and M-Pesa & Flutterwave for booking and rent payments, with an admin UI featuring collapsible navigation and room classification.

projects.title: SignBridge
projects.description: A real-time sign language translation application bridging communication for the hearing impaired, with a backend API layer supporting sign recognition and translation workflows.

projects.title: Nyayo Sentinel
projects.description: A national early warning dashboard with real-time sentiment monitoring using a RoBERTa NLP pipeline. Backend built with Next.js and Express, integrating Socket.io for live updates, county heatmaps, MFA via email OTP, and Claude-powered AI summaries.

projects.title: AI Climate Chatbot
projects.description: An AI-powered Telegram chatbot delivering climate insights through LLMs and RAG pipelines. Built for real-time data processing with a scalable Spring Boot backend.

projects.title: StoreSync
projects.description: A full retail management platform covering inventory, sales tracking, and customer management. RESTful APIs and automated processes cut manual errors by 40%.

projects.title: AfyaCheck
projects.description: A digital health platform for STI risk evaluation using dynamic questionnaires and ML-based risk scoring. Generates PDF reports and securely stores medical screening data. Extended with a native iOS app built in Swift.

projects.title: Apeiro Digital Website
projects.description: A Quarkus-based backend platform for the company website, handling image and article storage. Authentication via Keycloak integrated with Microsoft Entra ID restricts access to company-domain accounts, and the system is designed for reuse across the company's subsidiaries.

projects.title: Webchama 2.0
projects.description: A chama savings and table banking platform for the Kenyan market, built on Quarkus, React, PostgreSQL and Keycloak with M-Pesa payments. A ground-up rewrite of an earlier Laravel prototype.

projects.title: Keja Hub
projects.description: A student housing platform connecting students with landlords. Role-based dashboards for students, landlords and admins, with house listings, image uploads, bookings, reviews, email verification and landlord verification.

projects.title: Kadi iOS
projects.description: A native Swift/SwiftUI rebuild of the Kadi card game. Full game engine, LAN multiplayer over Bonjour, Firebase-backed online play, friends, chat, leaderboards, AI opponents and push notifications.
